text:
zara_ops: Heads up — CloudPort Marketplace notified us of a sudden slot reallocation. Two reserved burst slots for Q4 were assigned elsewhere. Impacting our buffer for hardware partner delays. Need plan.

ops-bot: marketplace-alert: provider=CloudPort slots_lost=[CP-7321, CP-7322] reason=reallocation

leo_partnerships: Which partner reservations rely on those marketplace slots? Is this tied to any Nimbus/Nimbus-like holds?

zara_ops: These were our planned overflow for AtlasGrid/Nimbus contingency in eu-west. Affected reservations: AV-1100 (dedicated buffer), AV-1101 (trial pool).

min_logistics: CloudPort says slots reallocated due to higher-priority marketplace order. They offer alternate windows but with 48h lead. They can prioritize if we pay a premium.

rafa_sales: For AV-1100 (enterprise buffer) we promised availability windows in SLO doc. Need options: A) pay premium and secure slots; B) accept 48h delay; C) request partner partial split.

anya_pm: We should avoid paying premium if partner (AtlasGrid) can split manifest. What's the delta if we hold and wait vs. paying?

nate_eng: Technically we can reroute to other regions for short bursts, but models pinned by customer region will need temporary token-based routing and cache warming. Latency hit expected ~80-150ms additional for eu customers routed to uk region.

leo_partnerships: Let's coordinate with AtlasGrid to see if they can prioritize the two racks for the eu pool instead of using marketplace. If not, what's premium?

min_logistics: CloudPort premium quote:  9.5k for immediate reallocation. Alternative: 48h delay window no cost. AtlasGrid response pending (asked them to hold two racks).

rafa_sales: Offer to enterprise customers: immediate hosted-burst routing + 50% credit on overage, or secure marketplace premium and avoid performance change. Need to decide quickly for cust-H and cust-I.

anya_pm: Draft playbook outline: Incident summary; Impacted reservations; Marketplace negotiation steps; Partner negotiation steps (AtlasGrid); Customer comm templates; Technical runbook (nate).

nate_eng: Runbook: 1) Prepare canary routing for 10% traffic; 2) Warm KV caches; 3) Allow model-variant fallback; 4) Throttle token rate to protect backend; 5) Monitor tail latency. I'll add CLI bits.

zara_ops: Who authorizes the  9.5k spend? Ops approval limit is  7k, above that needs finance sign-off.

leo_partnerships: I'll push AtlasGrid for manifest split and simultaneous hold on two racks. If they can't commit, we either pay premium or accept 48h delay and trigger hosted-burst.

min_logistics: Update 1.5h later -> AtlasGrid can split, but only if we accept a partial freight re-route fee of  3k and they need customs pre-clear for the split. CloudPort still holds the slots until we confirm.

rafa_sales: Given cost numbers, propose: pay AtlasGrid  3k to split and avoid paying CloudPort  9.5k. Offer customers hosted-burst for immediate need and then move to split racks once in-country.

anya_pm: I'll draft customer messages for cust-H and cust-I offering two choices: 1) short latency hit with hosted-burst (no extra cost, credit applied); 2) guaranteed local capacity after freight split (may have a 24h rolling window).

nate_eng: Note: if we plan to shift back to dedicated after split, ensure KV cache migration plan to avoid double-cold starts. Add warmup orchestration in runbook.

zara_ops: Also tag @legal for any freight amendment.

ops-bot: doc-created: /playbooks/cloudport-slot-realloc-response-draft by anya_pm

leo_partnerships: Next steps: Min secure split with AtlasGrid (approve  3k); Z will prep approval for marketplace premium if needed; Anya publish playbook and templates; Nate ready runbook. Reconvene in 3 hours.

min_logistics: Update 3h later -> AtlasGrid confirmed split pending our  3k approval; CloudPort released one slot back but still holds second until confirmation.

rafa_sales: Proceed with split and offer hosted-burst to any customer who requests immediate seamless experience. I'll prepare comms.

anya_pm: Playbook posted. Please review and file any missing steps.

nate_eng: Reviewed and added canary thresholds and rollback criteria. Also flagged potential token accounting issues when switching billing contexts across pools.

zara_ops: Approved  3k for split. Min, please sign off and secure the logistics LOI.

ops-bot: thread-closed: pending manifest split confirmation and customer ack
